title: The Biggest PSI Number on the Tire Is Not Automatically Your Target
topic: Tire sidewall maximum pressure is not the vehicle's recommended operating pressure
mechanicTruth: The pressure molded on a passenger tire sidewall is not automatically the vehicle's recommended operating pressure; the vehicle placard or owner guidance supplies the applicable cold-pressure target for the vehicle configuration.
